scoring_justification: Formation energies are recomputed from the submitted total energies using stoichiometries and elemental references, then compared to paper-reported values. Bulk moduli and band gap are directly compared. Recompute from the agent's raw artifact is feasible and is the strongest tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported formation energies (mRy/atom), bulk moduli (GPa), band gap (eV) from Table IV and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Table IV: beta -10.93 mRy/atom, beta'' 3.53, U1 -0.45, U2 -3.04; bulk moduli: beta 54.3 GPa, beta'' 65 GPa, U1 71 GPa, U2 69.1 GPa; band gap 1.77 eV from text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values from the source paper; they are the ground truth for reproduction.

required.total_energies: object with keys: Mg_hcp (eV/atom), Si_diamond (eV/atom), Al_fcc (eV/atom), beta_phase (eV/unit cell), beta_prime_prime_phase (eV/unit cell), U1_phase (eV/unit cell), U2_phase (eV/unit cell)
required.bulk_moduli: object with keys: beta_phase (GPa), beta_prime_prime_phase (GPa), U1_phase (GPa), U2_phase (GPa)

outputs.description: Compiler of DFT outputs: raw total energies of elemental references and precipitate phases, fitted bulk moduli, and direct band gap at Γ for β. The checker recomputes formation energies per atom from these total energies and compares all quantities to hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The scoring logic recomputes formation energies using the submitted total energies and compares each to the paper value; bulk moduli and band gap are compared directly. All comparisons use appropriate tolerances that respect toolchain spread.

steps.description: Recompute formation energies per atom in mRy from total energies and compare to paper values.
Compare bulk moduli directly to paper values.
Compare direct band gap at Γ for β phase.
